name: order_d_dimer
description: Orders a D-dimer test, a fibrin degradation product used primarily to rule out venous thromboembolism (VTE). A negative D-dimer has high negative predictive value for DVT and pulmonary embolism.

wells_score.description: Wells score for DVT/PE if available (low/moderate/high)

examples.query: Check D-dimer to rule out PE
